purpose.zh: 拉开屁股深处，胯发紧时松一松
purpose.en: Stretches deep in your butt to ease tight hips.

text.zh: 脚踝搭在另一条腿的大腿上，膝盖往外打开
text.en: Cross your ankle over your other thigh and let that knee fall open

text.zh: 仰躺，踩地的脚往屁股挪一点，头和肩膀放松。
text.en: Lie on your back, walk the planted foot in a bit, head and shoulders relaxed.

text.zh: 搭上去的脚勾住，膝盖往外推，屁股侧面有拉的感觉。
text.en: Flex the crossed foot and press that knee away. Feel it in the side of your butt.

text.zh: 呼气时把下面那条腿往胸口再抱近一点。
text.en: Each breath out, pull the bottom leg a little closer to your chest.

commonErrors.en: Lifting your head and tensing your shoulders.

commonErrors.zh: 头和肩膀抬起来去够腿
commonErrors.en: Lifting your head and shoulders to reach the leg.

cautions.zh: 膝盖外侧疼就把腿放低点，别抱那么近
cautions.en: If the outside of your knee hurts, lower the leg and don't pull it so close.
